dependency_order: A `research-paper` seeds prerequisites before methods, evidence, and claims that use them (§4.4).

slots.name: Abstract
slots.description: State the claim first in assumed-reader vocabulary. Include scope, strength, and a headline comparison where applicable.

slots.name: Introduction
slots.description: Research question, importance, main claim, and document map.

slots.name: Background from first principles
slots.description: The ladder-seeding section: admit every non-assumed term needed by the main line, in dependency order.

slots.name: Method or what we built
slots.description: Procedure and mechanism, with exact detail in bounded technical blocks when needed.

slots.name: Experimental setup
slots.description: Data or materials, conditions, comparisons, measures, and symbols needed to interpret the evidence.

slots.name: Results
slots.description: Observations and measurements. Include uncertainty and self-contained figures or tables where applicable.

slots.name: Discussion
slots.description: Interpretation, relation to prior evidence, and bounded generalization. Keep speculation labeled.

slots.name: Limitations
slots.description: Scope of validity, known failure modes, untested cases, and aggregation of claim-local caveats.

slots.name: Reproducibility statement
slots.description: Plain-language account of what repeating the work requires, distinct from an optional technical appendix.
